kevin: heads up — after today's release (commit a7f3c2e) we saw p99 tail latency jump on decoder-heavy requests for a subset of models. Canary showed +120ms p99 and +30ms p95. dashboard: https://redwood/obs/decode/pipeline/3412345678
ashok: ugh. did the rollout change kernel selector heuristics? iirc that PR switched preferring fused-attn-kernel on short seqs
samir: yep PR #2412 touched kernel_picker.py — changed score for fused_attn by +0.2. I posted a quick flamegraph: https://redwood/snapshots/fg-341234
maria: flamegraph shows 40% more time in attn_transpose path when kv cache is warm. looks like handoff to fallback kernel is happening mid-request
jonathan: infra-bot shows canary still at 10% in prod. can we hold/rollback the release? :warning:
infra-bot: deploy canary 2026-03-18T10:15Z -> status: partial, 10% traffic
ashok: let's not full revert yet. need a quick bisect to confirm if kernel selector change is root cause. can someone run git bisect locally against a representative load? I'll coordinate.
maria: repro script that triggers the tail: ```bash
# warm kv cache then send 1-token bursts
ab -n 1000 -c 16 -p short_prompt.json https://api.redwood/generate
``` logs attached show spikes when KV size > 1MB
samir: attaching perf snippet (stack samples): ```
attn_kernel::transpose  42%
decode_loop::generate  28%
fallback_attn_kernel::execute 18%
```
kevin: noted. if bisect confirms selector bump, we should reduce score and re-rollout. can someone try a hotfix to force preferring native-attn for warm-kv paths?
jonathan: I can push a quick flag to runtime: `RUNTIME_FORCE_NATIVE_ATTN=1` and run a small canary
ashok: also check batching heuristics — fused ops + larger batch size seems to amplify the spike. try limiting batch to 8 for canary
maria: i'm going to instrument KV eviction metrics and add a canary probe that measures p99 conditioned on kv_size>0
kevin: action items: 1) samir bisect kernel_picker.py 2) jonathan push runtime flag + canary 3) maria add kv probe 4) ashok evaluate batching cap. I'll pester support to divert extra logs to this thread
samir: running bisect now, will update with first failing commit or repro instructions
jonathan: pushed flag, canary at 2% now. early numbers look promising (p99 delta -80ms)
samir: bisect landed on commit a7f3c2e -> kernel_picker: bump fused_attn score. reverting that change locally removes spike
kevin: thanks — please open hotfix PR to revert score bump and tag for emergency patch release. include perf traces and kv-conditioned p99 graphs in PR
maria: ack. i'll attach graphs and a short note about fused op interactions with warm-kv
ashok: nice catch team. :thumbsup:
kevin: closing loop — if we see no regression after revert, schedule a deeper postmortem to understand fused-attn interaction with KV eviction and batching
support-bot: Note: alert routed to #incidents and oncall paged (pager duty)
